pairs.evidence: lib/studioArchiveRead.ts:59 The browser reader inflates a user-picked .gravitone file (ImportView.tsx readFile → inspectArchive → parseArchive) with no budget on inflated bytes, line length or line count, so a small gzip bomb exhausts the tab before the server's capped reader ever sees it. The two extraction sites are not routed through one defended door.

techniques.evidence: lib/studioArchiveRead.ts:59 The bomb class is unguarded: no total-bytes, per-line or entry-count budget while streaming. lib/import/archive.ts itself says 'v1 read whatever it was handed'. Verify-before-write does hold (parse at studioArchiveImport.ts:51 before the single readwrite transaction at :92).
